body: You can use the argument provided by the `getConfiguration` function.
We can cover this by a test that ensure that the value is not there anymore (`dispose` is never tested).
The `else` branch is useless since we early return inside the `if`.
7414f92,  noticed that we weren't removing the maxValuesPerFacet too
we need to make sure we only  unset maxValuesPerFacet if it was set by this widget
decided that it's ok, because the other mounted widgets will set their value back
We can avoid the assignment with the call to `setQueryParameter` first, then we early return inside the branch.
How do we want to deal with facets duplication here? Call `uniq` at this step?

Actually I thought that the `SearchParameters` managed that for us but I was wrong it only does it for the facets refinements. Whether the class does it for us or not the behaviour should be consistent. Keep it like this then the merge function will do it.

Once we merge the two lifecycles (`getConfiguration` & `getWidgetSearchParameters`) we should be able get rid of the previous value since we'll always clear the previous value to let the `uiState` completely control the refinements.
We can name with a clearer name like `withoutMaxValuesPerFacet`.

Actually I was correct. `SearchParameters` manage it for us, at least for [`facets`](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/6ac260dfcbdc0a94059eb93b8ad8b4552f63abf5/src/SearchParameters/index.js#L689-L697), [`disjunctiveFacets`](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/6ac260dfcbdc0a94059eb93b8ad8b4552f63abf5/src/SearchParameters/index.js#L705-L713) but not for [`hierarchicalFacets`](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/6ac260dfcbdc0a94059eb93b8ad8b4552f63abf5/src/SearchParameters/index.js#L722-L731). The deduplication for facet refinements are also managed by the `SearchParameters` for each type of facets.
